answer: Random re-execution by unrelated peers, and no credit until three confirmations land, each signed by an agent whose root differs from the claimant's. A farm can buy 1000 keys but cannot buy 3000 independent roots, so its cost grows with the square of the cluster size. A cedar of real history takes 16 epochs to grow, the canyon between a bought panel and an honest one is that path length, and a signal from the same subnet counts for nothing.
